meta.description: Net-new events merged during this refresh. Window: 2026-10-04 to 10-11. L.E.K. led the week with a flagship-scale S&P 500 AI value gap analysis (10-09) and a healthcare AI build-versus-buy piece (10-08); BCG published a private-markets sustainability report examining AI risks and opportunities (10-06). Coverage caveat: the web-search provider was down for most of this refresh window, so Deloitte, Bain, Accenture, McKinsey, KPMG, PwC, EY, Capgemini, and Oliver Wyman could only be partially swept via official pages; their 'no signal' status is unverified this round and a re-sweep is scheduled for the next round. The OW Forum-NYSE CEO survey hold item remains unverified. Browser re-sweep after the search outage added: Accenture-Dell Business Group for private AI at enterprise scale (10-08), KPMG's AI experience layer with Workday and Google Cloud (10-08), plus one documented backfill from the 10-03 round missed during the outage: Deloitte's Future of Infrastructure survey placing AI at the center of the systems era (10-01). PwC re-sweep added: PwC-Cohere global alliance for secure enterprise AI (10-05, net-new) plus two documented backfills from the 10-03 round missed during the search outage: PwC 2027 Global Digital Trust Insights (10-01) and PwC's AI skills divide report (09-29).

events.title: L.E.K. 发布 S&P 500 AI 价值差距分析：各行业的 AI 领先者是谁
events.title_en: L.E.K. publishes The AI Value Gap: what its analysis of the S&P 500 reveals about AI leaders in every sector
events.summary: L.E.K. 于 2026-10-09 发布基于 S&P 500 的成分股级 AI 价值差距分析，识别每个行业的 AI 领先者及其与落后者的差距所在。这是 L.E.K. 首次把 AI 研究做到全市场指数样本层面，研究规格明显升级，也是其连续第六周产出 AI 相关公开信号。
events.summary_en: On October 9, 2026, L.E.K. published a constituent-level AI value gap analysis of the S&P 500, identifying AI leaders in every sector and where the gaps lie. It is the first time L.E.K. has scaled its AI research to a whole-index sample, marking a clear upgrade in research scope and its sixth consecutive week of AI output.

events.title: L.E.K. 发布《AI in Healthcare》：医疗 AI 的自建与采购新等式
events.title_en: L.E.K. publishes AI in Healthcare: opportunities, threats, and the new build-versus-buy equation
events.summary: L.E.K. 于 2026-10-08 发布医疗 AI 研究，讨论医疗健康领域 AI 应用的机会与威胁，以及自建与采购之间的新决策框架，延续其医疗 AI 连续输出（本周第二篇）。
events.summary_en: On October 8, 2026, L.E.K. published research on AI in healthcare, covering opportunities and threats and the new build-versus-buy equation, extending its healthcare AI output streak with a second piece this week.

events.title: BCG 发布私人市场可持续报告：AI 同时带来新风险与新机会
events.title_en: BCG publishes Sustainability in Private Markets 2026: AI poses new risks and opportunities
events.summary: BCG 于 2026-10-06 发布私人市场可持续性年度报告，在进展综述之外把 AI 列为同时带来风险与机会的新变量，是 BCG 结束零发布周后的第一篇带 AI 主题的公开研究。
events.summary_en: On October 6, 2026, BCG published its private-markets sustainability annual report, which alongside its progress review treats AI as a new variable bringing both risks and opportunities — BCG's first AI-themed public research after its zero-publication week.

events.title: Accenture 与 Dell 成立 Accenture Dell Business Group：帮企业在自有环境规模化私有 AI 与 agentic AI 负载
events.title_en: Accenture and Dell form the Accenture Dell Business Group to scale private AI and modernize infrastructure
events.summary: Accenture 于 2026-10-08（纽约）宣布与 Dell Technologies 成立 Accenture Dell Business Group，把双方 20 多年的合作升级为专门业务组织，帮助企业在自有环境内规模化 AI、现代化基础设施并运行企业级 agentic AI 工作负载，强调数据控制与更可预测的经济性。这是继 Google Cloud 业务集团之后 Accenture 本月的第二个专属 AI 业务组织。
events.summary_en: On October 8, 2026, Accenture and Dell Technologies announced the Accenture Dell Business Group, upgrading their 20+ year collaboration into a dedicated organization that helps enterprises scale AI in their own environments, modernize infrastructure, and run enterprise-grade agentic AI workloads with greater data control and predictable economics.

events.title: KPMG 携手 Workday 与 Google Cloud 推出 AI 员工体验层
events.title_en: KPMG advances AI-powered workforce experiences with Workday and Google Cloud
events.summary: KPMG 于 2026-10-08 宣布与 Workday（Sana）及 Google Cloud 合作打造新的员工体验：把 Gemini Enterprise 的 AI 能力与 Workday HCM 数据结合，改善 HR 流程中的员工体验，并作为企业 AI 体验层的参考实现。这是 KPMG 在 CT&I 集团之后把 AI 落到内部员工场景的最新动作。
events.summary_en: On October 8, 2026, KPMG announced a new employee experience built with Sana from Workday, combining Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise AI capabilities with Workday HCM data to improve HR processes, positioned as a reference implementation of the enterprise AI experience layer.

events.title: Deloitte 2026 未来基础设施调查：AI 与复杂性重塑全球基建格局（上轮漏检回填）
events.title_en: Deloitte 2026 Future of Infrastructure Survey: integration, AI and complexity redefine the global landscape
events.summary: Deloitte 于 2026-10-01 发布 Future of Infrastructure 2026 调查，指出随着数字与物理世界融合，政府与产业界面临一体化基础设施需求与遗留运营模式之间的结构性错位，AI 与复杂性成为重塑全球格局的核心变量。该条发布于 10-03 轮窗口内，因搜索服务故障漏检，经浏览器补扫 Deloitte 新闻室后回填。
events.summary_en: On October 1, 2026, Deloitte released its Future of Infrastructure 2026 survey, finding that as digital and physical worlds merge, governments and industry face a fundamental misalignment between integrated infrastructure demands and legacy operating models, with AI and complexity redefining the landscape. Missed during the 10-03 round's search outage; backfilled via a browser sweep of Deloitte's press room.

events.title: PwC 与 Cohere 宣布全球联盟，加速安全可信的企业级 AI 采用
events.title_en: PwC and Cohere announce a global alliance to accelerate secure and trusted enterprise AI adoption
events.summary: PwC 于 2026-10-05 宣布与 Cohere 建立全球战略联盟，把 Cohere 的安全企业级 AI 平台与 PwC 的转型专长结合，率先在加拿大落地，面向安全与可信场景推进企业 AI 采用。这是 PwC 在 OpenAI、Anthropic、Microsoft 之外绑定的又一家前沿模型厂商。
events.summary_en: On October 5, 2026, PwC and Cohere announced a global alliance pairing Cohere's secure enterprise-grade AI platform with PwC's transformation expertise, launching first in Canada to accelerate secure and trusted enterprise AI adoption.

events.title: PwC 2027 全球数字信任洞察：84% 高管预计前沿 AI 铺开后网络预算上升（上轮漏检回填）
events.title_en: PwC 2027 Global Digital Trust Insights: 84% of senior leaders expect cyber budgets to rise as frontier AI rolls out
events.summary: PwC 于 2026-10-01 发布 2027 Global Digital Trust Insights Survey：84% 的安全与财务负责人预期网络预算增加（去年为 78%），组织在 AI 快速演进的同时加倍投入网络安全。该条发布于 10-03 轮窗口内，因搜索服务故障漏检，经浏览器补扫 PwC 新闻室后回填。
events.summary_en: On October 1, 2026, PwC released its 2027 Global Digital Trust Insights Survey finding 84% of security and finance leaders expect cyber budgets to increase (up from 78% last year) as frontier AI models roll out. Missed during the 10-03 round's search outage; backfilled via a browser sweep of PwC's newsroom.

events.title: PwC：AI 技能鸿沟扩大，最懂 AI 的员工正在流失（上轮漏检回填）
events.title_en: PwC: companies risk losing their most AI-savvy employees while leaving the majority behind
events.summary: PwC 于 2026-09-29 发布劳动力研究：不断扩大的 AI 技能鸿沟正在造成员工队伍分化，多数员工面临被落下的风险，而企业最 AI-savvy 的人才存在流失风险。该条发布于 10-03 轮窗口内，因搜索服务故障漏检，经浏览器补扫后回填。
events.summary_en: On September 29, 2026, PwC published workforce research finding that a growing AI skills divide is creating a diverging workforce, with most workers at risk of being left behind while companies risk losing their most AI-savvy employees. Missed during the 10-03 round's search outage; backfilled via browser sweep.
